root_cause: The suggestion list items have tabindex='0' (for Talkback screen reader support), making them focusable. When the list is open and the user presses Tab, focus moves into the list instead of to the next form field.
repair_strategy: Modify the keydown handler to close the suggestion list when Tab is pressed while the list is open (unless tabSelect is true and an item is selected), allowing the default Tab action to skip the now-hidden list and reach the next field.
expected_accessibility_effect: When suggestions are visible, a single Tab press moves focus from the city input to the dietary requirements input, preserving logical focus order and complying with WCAG 2.1.1 Keyboard and 2.4.3 Focus Order.
functional_risks: If a consumer has set tabSelect:true, the added Tab-close will not interfere because the tabSelect branch is checked first.
Removing reliance on list-item tabindex may affect assistive technologies that expect focusable options, but arrow-key navigation and aria-activedescendant remain unchanged.
verification_requirements: After typing 'Ber' in the city field, pressing Tab moves focus to the dietary requirements field.
The suggestion list is closed after the Tab press.
Arrow-up/down navigation within the list still works when the list is open.
Enter key still selects the highlighted suggestion and closes the list.
Esc key still closes the list.
Screen-reader announcements for the list remain functional.
